hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d||'{}');const cmd=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.command)||'';if(!/(^|[;&|]\s*)git\s+commit\b/.test(cmd))return;const r=require('child_process').spawnSync('npx',['tsc','--noEmit'],{encoding:'utf8',shell:true});const out=((r.stdout||'')+(r.stderr||'')).slice(0,1200);const v=r.status===0?{permissionDecision:'allow'}:{permissionDecision:'deny',permissionDecisionReason:'tsc 타입체크 실패 - 커밋 전에 오류를 먼저 고치세요.\n\n'+out};console.log(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:Object.assign({hookEventName:'PreToolUse'},v)}))})"

node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||'';if(/\.env(\.|$)/.test(f.split(/[\\/]/).pop())){console.log(JSON.stringify({systemMessage:'실제 API 키가 담긴 파일입니다. 값을 응답에 노출하지 않도록 주의하세요.'}))}})"
